Hey Doug, you should have explained CAS better with that huge drop-off beween Dec 2025 and Jan 2026. If you look at it's distribution history on the SimplyETFs website, the monthly distributions are small EXCEPT in December at the end of the year where all accumulated capital gains earned are paid-out. Look at Dec 2025 payment of $10.49 per share! This is less about geopolitics and more the way the funds are structured to payout dividends. It's that huge dividend payout that makes sense why the price drops so much at the end of every year. Thus, in January the cycle starts all over again but yes, no doubt geopolitics will contribute to it's volatility. Seems like a good entry point is to get in at the beginning of the year or right after that huge payout. However, the initial inception price was around $25 so a good support level to enter ay any given time is below $30 in my opinion.
